short_bio: American YouTuber, born Jimmy Donaldson, known for large-scale challenge and giveaway videos.
biography:
Jimmy Donaldson was born in Wichita, Kansas, and grew up in Greenville, North Carolina. He began posting on YouTube at 13. A 2017 video in which he counted to 100,000 brought his first large audience.

In 2019 he and Mark Rober launched Team Trees, which raised money to plant twenty million trees. He founded the charity Beast Philanthropy in 2020 and the snack brand Feastables in 2022.

In 2024 his main channel passed T-Series as the most-subscribed on YouTube. His competition series Beast Games premiered on Prime Video in December 2024.
